input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/softmax.dp.cpp. The file compiles with icpx -fsycl with no dpct include (0 errors, 0 warnings), and it no longer uses any dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros, or <dpct/...> includes. Kernel 1 (the default, formerly softMax2) uses one sub-group per slice. It strides over slices by sub-group id, and reduces with sycl::reduce_over_group using maximum and plus. The sub-group size is not hardcoded, so it is portable across device sub-group sizes. Kernel 0 (formerly softMax) uses one work-item per slice. Both kernels use sycl::exp rather than native::exp to stay close to expf. Output-order differences in the sum reduction should stay well inside atol 1e-6 for probabilities in [0,1]. Not verified: I have no tool that runs the binary, so I did not check the output against the CUDA reference numerically. The atol 1e-6 match still needs to be confirmed by running build/candidate and comparing the output file.
